claims.nl: The cabinets were installed crooked and the doors don't close — that's defective work Cyrus has to fix on his own dime.

claims.nl: The cabinetry was installed to spec and passed inspection — there's nothing defective to rework.

claims.nl: I never approved the bathroom change order — Cyrus did that extra work without my sign-off, so I don't owe it.
claims.english_render: It is not the case that Dana authorized the bathroom change order.

claims.nl: Dana told me to go ahead with the upgraded bathroom tile in person — the change order was authorized and is billable.
claims.english_render: Dana authorized the bathroom change order.

claims.nl: All told the extra charges come to about nine thousand dollars on top of the base contract.
claims.english_render: Cyrus's claimed total of extra charges is $9,000.00.
